consumer: An external graphing tool reading the snapshot JSON, asking 'what is the avatar's raw stored calorie count at this moment' so it can plot calorie history over time.
scope: The single raw authoritative scalar stored_kcal on the avatar (ground-truth world state), not a derived ratio or display proxy.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar exports json.member("stored_kcal", ctx.u.get_stored_kcal()), reading the engine's raw stored-calorie getter directly into the snapshot.
divergence: When stored_kcal exceeds the healthy maximum, get_kcal_percent() saturates near/at 100% while raw stored_kcal keeps climbing; graphing the percent would flatten a curve that the raw value shows still rising. The proposal exports raw stored_kcal, so it answers the goal correctly.
